params.body:
Each type on **Verkennen** now carries the mark the crew already sees on the worksheet screen (`x-icoon`), on the type buttons and on the tag in front of every row:

- Uren: clock
- Machines: machine
- Materiaal: box
- Werkfiches: shovel
- Signalen: warning triangle

The mapping is `Records::ICONS`, next to the labels. No new marks were drawn. The office menu stays text only.

Verkennen and share-link tests pass (14), pint clean. Checked in a browser against a local database with sample data.
params.title: Verkennen: icons for each type, from the worksheet's own marks
